title: A ${view.SQL_TABLE_NAME} reference follows the view's refined table
rule: A reference to a refined view reads the table the refinement sets, not the base view's table.

citations.quote: in most cases a refinement will override the original settings of an object
${view_name.SQL_TABLE_NAME} references another view or derived table.

rationale: The refinement replaces sql_table_name on orders, and the reference reads the orders view as the model resolves it.
